# Excalidraw converter fixtures

`synthetic-every-type.json` is handmade unit data, not an application export. Structural image-header cases in excalidraw.test.ts are also synthetic and do not claim complete codec validity.

`official-app-mixed.excalidraw` is the exact unchanged official excalidraw.com Save to file download captured through native UI on 2026-10-05 (Asia/Bangkok). It was renamed from ignored capture `original.excalidraw` without reparsing or modifying any bytes. Its SHA-256 is `dd49a1f29fefca2a51fee4c5983a570db27688a3fb003d11929a9af12305d55f`; tests pin that hash. `official-app-mixed.provenance.json` retains the original capture metadata and original artifact names; `official-app-mixed.procedure.md` retains the capture plan/procedure. References within those metadata describe the original capture directory, `test-results/verification/f2-real-export/`, rather than additional tracked fixture dependencies. Exact native action log, capture script, trace, loaded-build observations and screenshot evidence remain ignored there. The capture reports the loaded app bundle hash, without claiming the upstream HEAD commit was the deployed release. The scene uses synthetic test content, while the saved export itself is genuine official-app output.

`upstream-legacy-text.excalidraw` is the exact base64-decoded payload from official pinned upstream SVG export `test_embedded_v1.svg`, renamed from preparation `upstream-test-embedded-v1.excalidraw` with bytes unchanged. SHA-256 `f7a80231fe0a78f4b996b3373423c42a8fa1dbb0f3086d57d740597c796127a3` is pinned in tests. `upstream-legacy-text.provenance.json` records original source URLs/blob hashes and extraction procedure; its file references describe ignored `test-results/verification/f2-prep/` research downloads. This legacy artifact contains only one text element and cannot stand in for the mixed-type capture.
